cases.name: try-catch-finally
cases.source:
try
    result = 1
catch err as ArithmeticError
    result = 0
catch other as Error
    result = 1
finally
    cleanup = true

cases.name: nested-finally
cases.source:
ready = true
try
    while ready
        try
            break
        finally
            inner = "done"
finally
    outer = "done"
